inputs.style: Crushing early doom metal, deeply downtuned fuzz guitars, heavy tritone-laced new riff, enormous bass, swinging drums, raw haunted male baritone. 76 BPM, C sharp minor. slow massive syncopated riff with air between attacks, then a swinging double-time doom break. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Black smoke rises in a crooked line
The spire hisses, drawing the light in
We kneel on the gravel, we kneel on the rust
Counting the houses that the pit has dusted

[Chorus]
Tar Cathedral, drink the sky
Swallow the wall, let the roof fall by
Every prayer is a hole in the ground
We build it up, and it pulls it down

[Verse]
The priest pours a bucket of golden oil
Watches the pavement begin to boil
He says the hunger is holy and deep
It feeds on the living while we’re asleep

[Chorus]
Tar Cathedral, drink the sky
Swallow the wall, let the roof fall by
Every prayer is a hole in the ground
We build it up, and it pulls it down

[Bridge]
The ground groans a low and heavy sound
The spire cracks with a thunderous thud
It takes the altar, it takes the bell
Swallows the town where the shadows dwell

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Tar Cathedral, drink the sky
Swallow the wall, let the roof fall by
Every prayer is a hole in the ground
We build it up, and it pulls it down

[Chorus]
Tar Cathedral, drink the sky
Swallow the wall, let the roof fall by
Every prayer is a hole in the ground
We build it up, and it pulls it down

[Outro]
Just the smoke and the silence now
The well is full, and the dark is here
We are gone
